artworks.title: William Penn's Treaty with the Indians
artworks.medium: engraving and etching with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 42.7 × 59.1 cm (16 13/16 × 23 1/4 in.)
sheet: 48.9 × 60.9 cm (19 1/4 × 24 in.) (cut within platemark)
artworks.creditLine: The McNeil Americana Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historical scene depicting a treaty between European settlers and Native Americans. The scene shows a gathering of European settlers dressed in period clothing, engaging in a diplomatic interaction with a group of Native Americans adorned in traditional attire and headdresses. The environment is outdoors with large trees framing the left side, and several European-style buildings in the background. Beyond the buildings, there are ships visible in the distance, indicating a coastal setting. The sky is full of clouds, providing a dramatic backdrop. The painting includes detailed clothing textures and expressions conveying negotiation and discussion. This is in the style of Benjamin West.

artworks.title: Nudes Dancing around a Shadow
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black on Japan paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the gift of Nelson Blitz, Jr. and Catherine Woodard in Honor of Perri and Allison Blitz

artworks.title: Mascarade Chinoise faite a Rome (Chinese Masquerade)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene in a city, with a ceremonial procession. The perspective is frontal, showing a view of the scene. Buildings on both sides dominate the composition. The scene includes detailed buildings, a large column, and structures in the background. The sky has clouds and fine line work for texture. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and detailed crosshatching. The parade shows participants in elaborate costumes, some on horseback and others pulling a carriage.

artworks.title: Canoes
artworks.medium: color woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bob Stana and Tom Judy

artworks.title: The Attic Window
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bob Stana and Tom Judy
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person standing with one hand on their hip. The person's head is slightly tilted, with short hair and some geometric facial features highlighted. They are wearing a loose garment that appears to be a decorated dress or shirt. The background depicts an attic with slanted ceiling beams, wooden panel walls, and a large window behind the person, divided into multiple panes. A canvas or painting is standing on an easel to the right. The setting suggests an artist's studio or workspace. The composition uses bold lines and contrasting black and white, typical of a graphic print style.

artworks.title: A Standing Man with Cloak and Gloves
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Silvana Tagliavini Bareggi in memory of Riccardo Bareggi
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person with three-quarters of the body visible. The figure is slightly turned to the side, with the head facing the viewer. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the hair is styled simply. The clothing is indicated by flowing lines, possibly a robe or long garment. The person's arms are sketched in front of them. There is no jewelry or objects. The background is plain, and the sketch is done in a medium resembling red chalk or pastel on light-colored paper.

artworks.title: Marin Cureau de la Chambre
artworks.artist: Antoine Masson after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, from the chest up. He has long, curly hair falling to his shoulders, a small cap, a prominent nose, a small mustache, and deep-set eyes. He is dressed in period clothing with a high-collared shirt and a dark cloak draped over his shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a dark oval frame against a light, lined backdrop.

artworks.title: Die Grosse Grotte auf dem Heidelberger Schlosse (The Large Grotto at Heidelberg Castle)
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a grand, arched grotto from a low vantage point. The interior is dominated by stone arches extending upward into shadowy recesses. The walls are made of large, aged blocks with natural growth creeping over them. The artwork is monochromatic, possibly an etching, with textured brushstrokes emphasizing the stone's rough surfaces and light and shadow play. The color palette is subdued, using black, white, and gray to highlight the antiquity and mysterious atmosphere. Still water reflects parts of the structure and a small rowboat. Debris and growth are scattered in the distance, enhancing the tranquil and abandoned feel.

artworks.title: Die Halle auf dem Heidelberger Schlosse (The Hall of Heidelberg Castle)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a grand arched hall with a significant age and grandeur. The perspective allows viewing down the length of the hall, lined with large arches casting shadows on the floor. Bright light filters in from openings along the hall. The artwork features intricate linework and shading, detailed textures of stone surfaces and arches, creating depth and contrast. The color palette consists of shades of black, white, and various grays, emphasizing light and shadow. The monochromatic scheme adds a timeless feel to the architectural depiction.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher, Saint John the Baptist, the Virgin and Child, and Christ Blessing (recto)
artworks.artist: Master of the Drapery Studies, after Martin Schongauer
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various religious figures and scenes. The drawing shows detailed sketches of figures in religious attire, including one figure holding a child. The drawing features expressive lines capturing the intricate details of the garments. The style suggests inspiration from the Renaissance era. The figures are positioned in a way that suggests a narrative connection.

artworks.title: Babo Giorgio
artworks.medium: etching and roulette with hand coloring on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, resting their right hand on the side of their face while holding a basket in their left hand. The person has curly hair peeking out from underneath a large black hat with a decorative element. Their facial features suggest an older individual with discernible wrinkles and a moustache. They are dressed in a long blue coat over a dark garment, with a red sash or cloth partially visible, and white stockings paired with black shoes. A draped fabric hangs over their left shoulder with the text "BABO GIORGIO" visible. The background is plain and light in color.

artworks.title: Four Religious and Secular Compositions
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four horizontal sections depicting figures in various arrangements. The scenes include intertwined dynamic figures, a group of figures in a static setting, draped figures surrounding a reclining form, and a leisurely or celebratory gathering. The artwork features pencil or ink sketching lines, expressing movement, emotion, and interactions within a structured composition.

artworks.title: The North Prospect of the Cathedral Church of Oxford
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan and Daniel Mulcahy
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural illustration of the Cathedral Church of Oxford from a northward perspective. The horizon aligns with the upper midsection of the structure. The cathedral features intricate Gothic architecture with pointed arches and spires. The illustration is monochromatic in varying shades of grey and soft black, contrasting against a detailed sky. Small figures are depicted near the cathedral, while sparse trees are seen in the distance.

artworks.title: The North Prospect of the New Quadrangle of Christ Church in Oxford
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan and Daniel Mulcahy
artworks.description: The image is an architectural drawing of the North Prospect of the New Quadrangle of Christ Church in Oxford. The main structure, with a classical architectural style, features symmetrical columns and pilasters. The drawing is in a central perspective, facing the building, with figures in period attire and a dog in an open courtyard. It is depicted in monochromatic shades of gray and sepia, with detailed strokes and textured clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The South Prospect of the New Quadrangle of Christ Church in Oxford
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan and Daniel Mulcahy
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a grand, symmetrical quadrangle with a central building featuring a decorative cupola on its roof. Flanking the central building are long Georgian-style buildings with rows of windows. The scene is detailed with precise lines, giving the impression of an etching. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing form and shading. Figures of people and dogs are present near the observer, providing scale to the architecture. Patterns on the ground resemble pathways or garden designs, adding to the structured aesthetic.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Meadow and a Village Church
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a rural village with a church tower slightly to the right of the center. The viewpoint appears elevated, overlooking the village landscape with a low horizon line where fields meet structures. The church tower stands out against the sky. The etching displays precise lines detailing buildings and tree foliage. Figures, including a person with a walking stick and a dog, are in the foreground, with cattle and sheep in the field. Houses with thatched roofs and trees lead to the dominating church tower in the distance. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and white for contrast and depth.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper, laid down on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure reclining against a rock, looking towards the viewer. He has curly hair and a beard, deep-set eyes, and a strong nose. The man's muscular body is mostly uncovered, with a cloth around his lower hips and legs. In the foreground, there is a staff with an item on a rock. The background features fine lines indicating a natural setting.

artworks.title: A  Lonely Farm [Hawkridge]
artworks.medium: crayon-manner lithograph printed in black on coated wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a winding path leading to a thatch-roofed cottage surrounded by barren trees. The viewpoint is elevated, providing a clear view of the paths and the house. The horizon is blocked by trees, focusing attention on the cottage and surrounding trees. The artwork features soft brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement in the landscape. Details of the trees and ground are shown through lines and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly black, gray, and white, contributing to a somber atmosphere. The contrast and texture enhance the composition, emphasizing the tranquil yet eerie quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image features angular and curving lines creating an intricate tapestry of overlapping forms. In this scene, elongated and distorted figures with exaggerated limbs and faces suggest a chaotic atmosphere. The shapes converge like a collage of human forms intertwined with abstract elements, such as geometric patterns and flowing lines. A group of figures seem to be engaging with each other, reminiscent of a crowded gathering or procession. These abstract forms may evoke the hustle and bustle of a busy street or marketplace, with figures holding banners or items in motion. Despite its abstract nature, the scene maintains a semblance of human interaction, suggesting crowded activity.

artworks.title: No se convienen (They Do Not Agree)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, engraving, and burnishing on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a conflict scene. In the drawing, a central figure on horseback appears to be pointing or gesturing aggressively, while other figures on the ground seem to be engaged in a chaotic struggle or altercation. The scene is set against a dark background with stark contrasts. The drawing uses a strong, linear style to define the characters and actions within the composition. The lower part of the artwork includes the inscription "No se convienen."

artworks.title: Que valor! (What Courage!)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, engraving, and burnishing on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing behind a cannon, with her back facing the viewer. Her left hand is resting on the cannon, and her dark hair is pulled back into a bun. She is wearing a long dress and there are bodies on the ground around her. The background is a barren landscape with a faint hill in the distance. The woman is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The scene is depicted in grayscale.

artworks.title: Komposition
artworks.medium: linoleum cut in black on cream wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image displays bold, black lines and sharp angles arranged in an abstract composition. The dominant shapes resemble human figures and suggest stylized silhouettes or shadowy outlines in dynamic poses. The forms could be interpreted as three figures standing closely surrounded by jagged edges, implying movement and energy. The composition may evoke the sense of people in conversation or interaction, presented in a stylized and abstract way.

artworks.title: House with Greenhouse, Virginia
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a vintage, framed sepia-toned photograph of a grand manor in an elevated landscape. The viewpoint is head-on, displaying the architectural features clearly. The horizon is marked by the manor's roofline and surrounding trees. The manor's structure is symmetrical with windows and a central entrance, flanked by trees. Below the manor is a greenhouse with a glass roof divided into sections. The photograph is framed in gold, giving it a formal, vintage look. The color scheme is warm and aged, adding a nostalgic feel to the image.

artworks.title: The Queensborough Bridge
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bob Stana and Tom Judy
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a large truss bridge spanning from left to right. The upper portion of the bridge is made of metal beams, towering across the scene. The horizon is partially hidden by the bridge, with a cityscape visible in the distance. There are buildings and smoke in the background. The brushstrokes are linear, depicting the details of the bridge and surrounding architecture. The color scheme is monochromatic, with browns and dark sepia tones. The water below has ripple patterns and reflections of the bridge. Leafy branches frame the scene.
